name: TrophyUnlock
description: game-side trophy unlock; idx==ACH number; writes record + syncs to Steam via 1fdc0f0

name: SteamSetAchievement
description: ISteamUserStats vtbl+0x30 SetAchievement with ACH_%03d, idx<0x40

name: SteamSetAchievementProgress
signature: bool SteamSetAchievementProgress(SteamStatsObj* o, uint idx, int v)

name: TrophyCheckStoryAndBossFlags
description: polls main progress ids 1000..6500 (idx4-11: Shingen,Yoritomo,Himiko,Yoshinobu,Hiruko,ending) and mission flags 0x128-0x12A,0x20F-0x211,0x1A6/7 (idx41-50)

name: MissionFlagReadAllSlots
signature: uint* MissionFlagReadAllSlots(obj* o, uint* out, uint flagId)
description: bitmask of the 6 NG slots for a mission flag

name: MasterDefeatedMark
signature: void MasterDefeatedMark(obj* o, uint masterId, char v)
description: sets master-defeated bit; unlocks Masterful Pupil (idx 0x14)
